anchor.title: The Great Seal of the State of Tennessee
anchor.creator: State of Tennessee
anchor.caption: The Great Seal of the State of Tennessee (statehood 1796) — the emblem of the state government whose executive, legislative, and judicial branches this standard examines.
anchor.alt: The Great Seal of the State of Tennessee: a round seal reading 'The Great Seal of the State of Tennessee', with the words Agriculture and Commerce and the year 1796.
anchor.rights: Public domain — U.S. state government insignia.

anchor.title: Tennessee County Map (all 95 counties)
anchor.creator: U.S. Census Bureau (cartographic boundary, derivative)
anchor.caption: Tennessee's ninety-five counties — the county layer of local government that covers every part of the state. No single county is singled out; find your own on the map.
anchor.alt: Map of Tennessee divided into all ninety-five counties, each shaded a different pastel color, no labels.
anchor.citation: U.S. Census Bureau county boundaries, via Wikimedia Commons · https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tennessee_county_map,_cb_500k.svg
anchor.rights: Public domain — derived from U.S. Census Bureau data (federal government work).

anchor.title: Flag of Tennessee
anchor.creator: State of Tennessee (design by LeRoy Reeves, 1905)
anchor.caption: The Tennessee state flag: its three stars stand for the three Grand Divisions — East, Middle, and West — the state you will identify your own governor and legislators from.
anchor.alt: The Tennessee state flag: a red field with a blue circle holding three white stars, and a blue and white vertical bar at the fly.
anchor.rights: Public domain — official state flag design (1905).
